purpose: Extend official-event identity evidence for the immutable W4-C R1 backlog of 1,743 W4-B UNRESOLVED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH exact groups, without mutating W4-B truth, changing frozen event semantics, or inspecting linked-asset realized outcomes or prediction-market performance.

w4b_official_truth_protocol.relationship: R1 inherits the W4-B family semantics, source hierarchy and W4OT1 identity formula; it may tighten or extend deterministic evidence-retrieval rules but may not relax authority requirements or rewrite W4-B results.

eligible_universe_binding.sorted_group_ids_serialization: UTF-8 exact_group_id values sorted lexicographically, joined by LF, with one terminal LF

frozen_backlog_profile.interpretation: These counts define work allocation only. They are not priority weights based on performance and may not be changed after R1 evidence is observed.

identity_and_semantic_invariants.family_semantics: Use the frozen W4-B resolved_family and pretruth subject semantics exactly as recorded. R1 cannot reinterpret an event into another family to obtain a match.
identity_and_semantic_invariants.pretruth_date: Preserve pretruth_event_reference_date as provenance. A verified official occurrence date may differ and the delta must be recorded; the pretruth ID is never rewritten.
identity_and_semantic_invariants.existing_w4b_official_ids: If an R1 exact group maps to an already-existing W4-B W4OT1 identity, record it as an alias-to-existing-official-event. It contributes zero marginal unique official-event N and does not mutate the W4-B record.
identity_and_semantic_invariants.new_r1_official_ids: A new W4OT1 identity may be minted only from authoritative occurrence/date/subject evidence under this protocol. It remains W4-C extension evidence and never retroactively changes W4-B counts.

source_authority_contract.policy: Only primary official authorities or the explicit W4-B fallbacks below may vote. Search engines, prediction-market pages, news media, aggregators and model outputs may assist navigation but never constitute verification evidence.

conditional_authorities.OFFICIAL_REGULATOR: Must be the named government competition/regulatory authority for the event and use an explicit official government/regulator domain captured in evidence.
conditional_authorities.OFFICIAL_COURT: Must be the court or official judiciary/docket authority for the identified case; commercial docket mirrors cannot vote.
conditional_authorities.ISSUER_IR: May vote only where the W4-B hierarchy explicitly permits issuer evidence and the issuer identity/domain is deterministically bound to the frozen subject/entity.

stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.common_match_rule: Verification requires one uniquely supported real-world event identity consistent with the frozen family and subject/entity semantics. Multiple plausible official events, unresolved entity identity, semantic-phase mismatch, or insufficient primary evidence remain UNRESOLVED_R1; ambiguity may never be broken using market settlement, price, PnL or linked-asset returns.
stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.earnings_rule: Identify the issuer and reporting event using frozen venue metadata plus SEC/issuer occurrence metadata. Match on issuer plus reporting period when the period is available; otherwise require a unique issuer earnings event temporally and semantically supported by frozen metadata. Do not use, extract for voting, or persist actual EPS/revenue values to establish identity; numeric strike/threshold text is not an official-event identity key.
stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.litigation_rule: Require deterministic case/matter identity or a uniquely identified material legal event tied to the frozen entity and semantic event. Generic company litigation mentions are insufficient. Preserve case identifiers when official evidence provides them.
stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.fda_rule: Require deterministic sponsor/product/action identity and authoritative FDA occurrence evidence. Approval/nonapproval direction is not needed for identity and must not be used for route selection.
stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.ma_rule: Preserve the frozen transaction phase. Pre-announcement/rumor, pending completion and regulatory clearance are distinct semantic event types and may never be interchanged to obtain a match.
stratum_A_nonmacro_extension.antitrust_rule: Require the named company/matter plus an official regulator or court enforcement event consistent with the frozen family.

stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.prior_failure_reason: zero primary official occurrences within frozen +/-3 calendar-day window
stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.policy: First use explicit target period/date semantics already present in frozen venue metadata when available. Only if those semantics do not uniquely identify an official occurrence may the fixed family-specific fallback window below be used. Every match must remain unique within its window and subject/family; otherwise it remains UNRESOLVED_R1.
stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.weekly_claims_rule: The +/-3 day identity window remains unchanged for weekly initial jobless claims. R1 may improve exhaustive official archive traversal, but may not widen the weekly window after evidence is observed.
stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.period_semantics_rule: If frozen venue metadata explicitly identifies a release month, quarter, meeting or reference period, official evidence must correspond to that same period. A nearby release for a different period is not a match.
stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.uniqueness_rule: Exactly one authoritative official occurrence may satisfy the frozen subject/period and fallback window. Zero or multiple candidates remain unresolved.
stratum_B_macro_schedule_extension.macro_values_prohibited: Release values, surprises, revisions and directional results are unnecessary for identity and may not be persisted in R1 evidence outputs or used for matching decisions.

allowed: frozen venue event/market titles, slugs, descriptions and date metadata already materialized before R1
existing W4-B candidate-edge and exact-group membership metadata
forbidden: prediction-market outcome price or final price
prediction-market volume/liquidity/open interest for verification priority

evidence_capture_contract.source_capture: Hash the retrieved official body/document whenever technically possible. If deterministic body capture is blocked, record authority, URL, retrieval time, access status and a reproducible structured evidence reference; never fabricate hashes.
evidence_capture_contract.navigation_only_sources: Non-official search/index services may only locate candidate official URLs. Their snippets or metadata cannot vote or be stored as truth evidence.

marginal_capacity_accounting.r1_verified_exact_groups: Count of the 1,743 eligible exact_group_id values with VERIFIED_R1_OFFICIAL_TRUTH.
marginal_capacity_accounting.r1_verified_unique_official_events: Count of unique W4OT1 official_event_id values among R1 verified records.
marginal_capacity_accounting.r1_aliases_to_existing_w4b_official_even: R1 verified groups whose W4OT1 already exists in the immutable W4-B 344-event official universe.
marginal_capacity_accounting.r1_new_unique_official_events_vs_w4b: Unique R1 W4OT1 IDs not present in the immutable W4-B official-event universe. This is the only R1 quantity eligible to be called marginal unique official-event gain.
marginal_capacity_accounting.combined_w4b_plus_r1_truth_unique_events: 344 + r1_new_unique_official_events_vs_w4b. This is an official-truth coverage count only and is not N_final_backtestable.

post_gate_rule.next_step: Reapply the frozen W4-C marginal-capacity/saturation logic using R1 truth-extension outputs and remaining route capacity before deciding whether to proceed to R2.
